paragraphs.text: Kequia Akosa is the daughter of Niambi and granddaughter of Teferi Akosa . She was born in Femeref on Dominaria , and was invited to join the first official multiplanar class of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . She aspires to join Lorehold , the college of history and archeology.

Kequia is a young human girl from Femeref with deep brown skin, dark curls, and a golden headband that keeps her hair neatly in place. She always dresses elegantly and has inherited her mother Niambi's warm and compassionate nature. Although Kequia is still young, her presence reflects a deep strength and resilience, as suggested by her name, which means "fighter." Her demeanor is both gentle and determined, indicative of the spirit her mother saw in her even before her birth. Kequia's early life has been marked by a sense of purpose and the warmth of family, which supports her growth into a figure of hope and tenacity.

Kequia is a psychometrist , able to absorb knowledge from objects by touch. She is bright and energetic, and prefers conversation to confrontation. She carries a book with her everywhere, always has a question on the tip of her tongue, and has an encyclopedic knowledge of everything from inter-planar history to the campus handbook. To her, history is an instruction manual for not making the mistakes over and over again — and she doesn't like making mistakes more than once.
Kequia is fond of Sewa Bark tea.

Kequia was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina , because she had been identified as an ember ; a potential Planeswalker and powerful wizard. It is unknown if the Desparkening had any influence on her potential to ignite . This may yet come true under the right conditions.

On Arcavios, Kequia formed a class with the ambitious Eula Blue , the mysterious Segante , the merfolk Alandra , and the minotaur Jamira . During her first year, she learned to expand the application of her psychometry, learning to make objects manifest their old function. However, she also her powers to check the schedules of her professors and to change the grades of her fellow students to make sure she would be top of the class.

Kequia and the other multiplanar students quickly became a target for enemies within and without. Although they bonded, they found that various forces were active to isolate them emotionally from each other. In a secret plot, Professor Kasmina also endeavored to create tensions between the classmates. This didn't prevent her from falling in love with Jamira.

It was revealed that Kasmina had selected the five students because they had the potential to be powerful planeswalkers. Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own. This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl .

Afterward, Professor Vess had to task to to punish the five students for their various transgressions, with consideration of Kasmina's role. She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges, but forbade them to relocate to the appropriate dorms. This also allowed them to serve as residential advisors to the next incoming class of cross-planar students.
